### M0-E01 · Peek at the first five books

> **SOURCE · demonstrated in the lecture**  
> Source: [lecture2 L42-48](../../sources/lecture2.txt) *“but limit now to the first five rows”*

| Topic / concepts | Difficulty | Skills | Dataset | Task type |
|---|---|---|---|---|
